name: Santa María de Valverde (Spain)
description: Seven horizontal stripes alternating red and green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Santa María de Valverde.
history: The flag was approved and published at the same time as the arms and is a rectangular cloth whose length is one and a half times its height; the base of the arms bears the arms of the Cistercian order, referring to the place's dependence on the monastery of San Salvador de Santa Colomba de las Monjas by royal donation until it passed to the council of Benavente in the fifteenth century.

features.role: Santa María de Valverde arms — tree on green, a wheel on blue and the arms of the Cistercian order
